request.description: A very broad hollow ancient oak tree creature, barrel-shaped split trunk, small watchful face recessed into a dark natural hollow, thick uneven low root feet, one heavy branch arm and one short broken limb, sparse moss and one tiny pale shelf mushroom. Wide and low imposing silhouette, gnarled uneven crown of bare branches, no pointed humanoid head, no human chest, no armor. Calm ancient power, left-facing three-quarter battle pose. Dungeon Matcher native 96x96 pixel-art concept sprite, full body at the same source pixel density as the approved cast, approximately 70-82 pixels of occupied height, transparent background with no ground shadow or text. Warm matte bark #4A2C1C #7A4D2E #B07A43, restrained pale deadwood #9F907A #E0D2B8, olive moss #393728 #665F3D #908E58, outline #0A0D11. Aim for 14-18 opaque colors; broad connected base/shadow/light clusters, one-pixel contour, top-left lighting. No gradients, dithering, shiny metal, glowing magic, many small leaf marks, weapons or root-spell effects. Slow ancient miniboss identity, readable charming face.
